items.stem: Which command displays the absolute path of the directory you are currently working in?

options.rationale: Correct: pwd prints the full path of the present working directory.
cd changes the working directory; it does not print the current path.
ls lists directory contents, not the current path.
whoami prints the current username, not the directory.

items.explanation: Correct: pwd prints the full path of the present working directory.

items.stem: A file listing shows permissions -rwxr-x---. Which statement is true about the 'others' category?

options.text: Others have read and execute but not write
options.rationale: Those are the group bits (r-x); the others bits are the final three (---).

options.text: Others have no access to the file
options.rationale: Correct: the final three characters --- mean others have no read, write or execute permission.
Full access would be rwx in the last triad, not ---.

options.text: Others can write but not read
options.rationale: Write without read would be -w-, not ---.

items.explanation: Correct: the final three characters --- mean others have no read, write or execute permission.

items.stem: Select TWO characteristics that are true of free and open-source software licences.

options.text: The source code is available to study and modify
options.rationale: Correct: access to source for study and modification is a defining trait of open-source licences.

options.text: Redistribution of the software is permitted under the licence terms
options.rationale: Correct: open-source licences grant the right to redistribute, subject to their conditions.

options.text: The software may never be used for commercial purposes
options.rationale: Open-source licences generally do not forbid commercial use; that would fail the open-source definition.

options.text: Only the original author may ever compile the code
options.rationale: Anyone receiving the source may compile it; this is central to open source.

options.text: The licence always forbids charging any fee
options.rationale: Open-source licences allow charging a fee, for example for distribution or support.

items.explanation: Correct: access to source for study and modification is a defining trait of open-source licences.
